## Big idea

**ORM:** map objects ↔ tables. Hibernate is a common JPA provider.

```text
Entity class  ↔  table
Field         ↔  column
id            ↔  primary key
```

## Practice

Use JPA annotations (`@Entity`, `@Id`) and `EntityManager` or Spring Data to save/find entities. Watch SQL with `show-sql=true`.
